_comment: Wet weather + emergent dry line (POLISH card). Water is a layer on the track evolution grid, 0..1 per cell. Rain adds rainPerSec x intensity; without rain a cell dries dryPerSec (offLineDry x slower where nobody drives); each wheel clears clearPerSec x its load share x speed / clearRefMps (up to 2x) from its cell: that is the dry line. Rain washes rubber (washRubberPerSec) and marbles (washMarblesPerSec) at full rain. wetRubber: at full water rubber's grip bonus becomes -wetRubber x it (rubber is slippery in the wet). aquaplane: deeper than depth above speedMps, that wheel's grip x grip. Sessions: Wet = rain at wet.intensity all session, the track starting at wetStartWater; Changeable = dry, then a seeded shower (start in startSec, length in lengthSec, intensity in intensity, ramping over rampSec), then dry. Tyres in the wet: config/strategy.json compounds (water grip, and inters / wets overheat on a dry track). ai: pit for inters above interAbove water under its line, wets above wetAbove, back to slicks below slickBelow (averaged over the next lookM).
